title: SceneAxi Profile Conformance claim (v1)
description: Versioned claim that a profile package consumes the shared agent-native core. A development-consumer claim is exercised by the shared Profile Conformance suite (kernel session + document propose/apply + evidence-hook presence). This contract does NOT authorize shipping, publication, or resolution of the open held key profile-rollout-order — shippingClaim MUST be false. Behavioral suite: packages/schemas/src/profile-conformance-suite.ts; first development consumer: packages/profile-game (sceneaxi#10).

schemaVersion.description: Profile Conformance contract major version. Major mismatch refuses.

profile.description: Workspace profile package name this claim is about.

claimStatus.description: development-consumer = first (or later) development consumer of the shared suite; not-yet-claimed = profile exists but makes no conformance claim (must not fail the suite). Neither status is a shipping readiness claim.

corePin.description: Semver range of the core train this profile pins (must match sceneaxi.corePin on the package manifest and ProfileSeam.corePin).

suiteVersion.description: Shared conformance suite major version this claim targets.

evidenceHooks.description: Evidence-hook presence declaration. Full Evidence Packet emission remains later tickets; presence of declared hooks is what the suite checks today.

present.description: Hooks must be declared present for a development-consumer claim.

status.description: declared = hook surface exists; active emission is a later ticket.

heldKeysCited.description: Open captain holds this claim explicitly does not answer. MUST include profile-rollout-order.

shippingClaim.description: MUST be false. This contract never authorizes shipping or publication of a profile.
